mathematical_authority.analytic_parallel_point: For source rational point P(t), homogeneous tangent H=(Hx,Hy), and exact signed offset d, the retained point is P(t)+d*(-Hy,Hx)/sqrt(Hx^2+Hy^2). The chosen positive norm branch and retained parameter isolator determine exact interval bounds.
mathematical_authority.concentric_transport: For selected-circle center C and radial scale s, re-offset transport is Q=C+s*(P-C)+T. Exact Real coefficients and the original mapped parameter remain authoritative.
mathematical_authority.complement_relation: Equivalent coincident-circle maps transport reversed parameters by u=1-t. The equality is replayed from retained overlap orientation and exact source identities, not coordinate approximation.
mathematical_authority.adjacent_chord: If one chord endpoint is the authored circle endpoint and the other lies strictly inside the circle disk, convexity puts every open chord point inside the disk, leaving exactly one circle/chord contact.
mathematical_authority.structural_endpoint_fast_path: Pointer/source-backed PartialEq identity is checked across both chord endpoints before geometric equality. If absent, the prior exact same_point proof remains the complete fallback.
mathematical_authority.persistent_representation: Public CurveRegion2 and retained point handles remain one Arc word. The analytic source, mapped parameter, and derived affine transform are shared rather than copied.

benchmark_method.regression_wall: Nine alternating pinned CPU 11 process pairs, one Runner sample per process, eight timed operations after one Runner warm-up.
benchmark_method.regression_perf: One pinned perf-stat process per matched artifact and disabled control, 32 timed operations plus one Runner warm-up; subtract disabled and divide by 33.
benchmark_method.regression_heap: Heaptrack record-only, 32 timed operations plus one Runner warm-up; subtract the disabled process and divide by 33. Massif exports supply exact peaks.
benchmark_method.capability_wall: Nine fresh pinned CPU 11 processes per mode, 64 timed operations, one warm-up, and one preflight. End-to-end mode reconstructs the cap inside each operation; prebuilt mode isolates offset and regularization.
benchmark_method.capability_perf: Pinned perf stat, prebuilt mode, 64 timed operations plus one warm-up and one preflight; subtract the disabled process and divide by 66.
benchmark_method.capability_heap: Heaptrack record-only, prebuilt mode, 32 timed operations plus one warm-up and one preflight; subtract the disabled process and divide by 34. Recorder counts and Massif peaks are reported.
benchmark_method.competitive_caveat: Cavalier Contours 0.7.0 receives a binary64 bulge representation. It supplies neither exact selected fields nor Hypercurve policy outcomes, retained proof evidence, certified topology, or guarantee-equivalent regularization.
benchmark_method.historical_caveat: dc7c257 returns unsupported before exact cap construction. Its nanosecond result measures rejection latency, not a correctness-equivalent operation.
